about.description: Seven questions are carefully crafted by Priscilla, shaped by her curiosity about the person sitting across from her. The half question is different: it comes from AI. Unexpected, unpredictable, and entirely out of Priscilla's hands a question neither interviewer nor interviewee knows in advance.
